title: DCP-AI canonicalization candidate: design corpus
status: NON-NORMATIVE DESIGN CORPUS. Not a conformance requirement; no SDK implements or accepts dcp-jcs-v2.

provenance.note: Same cases, mappings, revisions and expectations as the approved design-2 corpus; only the paths, this field and the hash of the baseline copy differ.

how_to_read.file: ASCII JSON. Decode it with any JSON parser first.
how_to_read.input_json / input_hex: The exact input bytes: UTF-8 of input_json, or hex when not UTF-8 or starting with a BOM.
how_to_read.mode: document: one unit, ingress and canonical output. bundle: a synthetic signed bundle through transport, selection, policy and the candidate path.
how_to_read.transport: bare: the input is the unit. envelope: the unit is the one "signed_bundle" member of the input.
how_to_read.expected.offset: Byte offset relative to the unit. transport_offset is relative to the whole input.
how_to_read.expected.result: accept (document), accept_v2, v1_path (delegated to today's dcp-jcs-v1 verifier; its verdict is not computed), reject.
how_to_read.historical: Only for units the scanner cannot walk: what today's parser of an SDK does (fails, or the profile value it reads).
how_to_read.policy: accepted_canonicalization_profiles; every bundle case states it. No default.
how_to_read.options.depth_scope: "transport" reproduces the v0.3 rule, for comparison only.
how_to_read.why: The rule the expectation applies, written by hand.

original_corpus.run_as: document mode, bare transport, with the r2 expectations

scope_revisions.r2: Counted over the whole input document, including any bundle envelope: a payload inside a signed bundle starts at depth 4.
scope_revisions.design: Counted from the root of the validated unit (the signed bundle bytes), never over a transport envelope.
scope_revisions.effect_on_r2_cases: None: every r2 case is a bare unit.
